name: handles-public-api
description: A downloadable and containerized decentralized API for Handles
author: Papa Goose <papa.goose@koralabs.io>

scripts.readonly: ENABLE_OGMIOS_SCANNING=false USE_LAMBDA_SCANNER=false PORT=3142 tsx -r tsconfig-paths/register -r dotenv/config express.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: chmod +x ./shell/local_valkey.sh && REDIS_HOST=127.0.0.1 REDIS_PORT=6380 ./shell/local_valkey.sh && (export NETWORK=preview REDIS_HOST=127.0.0.1 REDIS_PORT=6380; jest -c jest.e2e.config.ts --forceExit --runInBand)
scripts.test:critical: chmod +x ./shell/local_valkey.sh && REDIS_HOST=127.0.0.1 REDIS_PORT=6380 ./shell/local_valkey.sh && (export NETWORK=preview REDIS_HOST=127.0.0.1 REDIS_PORT=6380; jest -c jest.critical.config.ts --forceExit --runInBand)
scripts.build:lambda: npm run copy-dist-files && (cd dist && npm install) && npm exec -c 'rollup -c rollup.lambda.config.js'
scripts.build:docker: npm run build:production && docker build -t koralabs/handles-api .
scripts.copy-dist-files: mkdir -p dist && cp rollup.package.json dist/package.json && cp docs/swagger.yml dist/swagger.yml
